name: solmar-open-world
description: [![Solmar](https://make.fun/badge/gta6-01.svg)](https://make.fun/gta6-01) [![Rank](https://make.fun/badge/gta6-01/alfasurya91/solmar-open-world/rank.svg)](https://make.fun/gta6-01/alfasurya91/solmar-open-world) [![Reward](https://make.fun/badge/gta6-01/alfasurya91/solmar-open-world/reward.svg)](https://make.fun/gta6-01/alfasurya91/solmar-open-world) Solmar is a top-down 2D coastal-city game rendered into a single canvas: walk the sidewalks, hotwire parked cars, and outrun the police across a procedurally seeded open world with no engine, bundler, or build step.
author: alfasurya91

scripts.test: node -e "const{readdirSync,readFileSync}=require('node:fs');const{execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const d='game/src';const files=readdirSync(d).filter(n=>n.endsWith('.js'));for(const n of files)execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',d+'/'+n],{stdio:'inherit'});if(!readFileSync('game/index.html','utf8').includes('./src/main.js'))throw new Error('game/index.html no longer loads ./src/main.js');console.log('ok: '+files.length+' game modules parse, index.html loads ./src/main.js')"
